policy.status: Native outcome/cost baseline for 214 spells: 110 Iron adaptations, 100 Pathfinder adaptations and four examples. Trait units remain relative.

abyssal_shroud.review: Three full-hit dodges within three seconds; thirty-second recovery replaces unlimited six-second immunity.

acid_orb.review: 3 HP in radius 2 plus brief Weakness; lower damage pays for disruption.

acupuncture.review: Five 1.5-HP targeted needles, at most 1.875 HP leech; reliable convergence costs more than a bolt.

angel_wing.review: Ten seconds of temporary flight with owned cleanup; twenty-second recovery leaves exposure windows.

arcane_lock.review: Owner-only container toggle; persistent access utility, short recovery without combat power.

arcane_shackle.review: Up to three four-second tethers, each with ten destructible HP; wider control pays more than Root.

arrow_volley.review: Twelve 3-HP rain arrows, at most four hits per creature; accuracy determines actual damage.

ascension.review: Upward launch, four-second Slow Falling, and 5 HP close burst; safety utility carries much of its value.

ball_lightning.review: 5 HP impact plus up to eight 1-HP area pulses; slow delivery exposes the orb.

black_hole.review: Up to sixteen 2-HP pulses over eight seconds in radius 5 with moderate pull; six targets per pulse, destructible.

blaze_storm.review: Ten 2-HP projectiles over 2.7 seconds plus brief fire; aim, obstruction, interruption constrain output.

blessing_of_life.review: 5 HP to one ally; matches Heal while trading self access for reach.

blight.review: Ten seconds of 50% healing suppression plus Poison; specialized value against sustain, cooldown exceeds debuff.

blizzard.review: Up to twelve 1.5-HP pulses over six seconds, radius 5 with brief refreshed slow/freeze; destructible field.

blood_needles.review: Five 2-HP spread needles; 10 HP requires all hits, with at most 2.5 HP leech.

blood_slash.review: 7 HP to at most three pierced creatures, 15% actual-damage leech; narrow line rather than a broad blast.

blood_step.review: Eight-block teleport and two-second invisibility; longer recovery pays for aggro clearing.

burning_dash.review: 6 HP once per contacted creature plus short burn; eight collision checks cannot multiply damage.

chain_creeper.review: 6-HP initial blast, bounded two-generation death propagation; spread depends on killing marked victims.

chain_lightning.review: 6 HP across up to four visible linked targets; higher aggregate value pays for mana and recovery.

charge.review: Ten seconds of Speed II and Haste I, fifteen-second recovery; movement tradeoff versus party Haste.

cleanse.review: Remove harmful statuses from at most six allies; narrow reactive value with no healing.

cone_of_cold.review: Sixteen 1.25-HP cone pulses over three seconds plus freeze/slow; shorter reach and interruptible channel.

counterspell.review: Twenty-four-block ray interrupt/dispel; no damage, but removes buffs, summons, and casting.

devour.review: 6 HP and 15% leech at five-block range; killing blow grants 2 max HP for thirty seconds.

divine_smite.review: 6 HP plus half weapon damage in a three-block melee cone; equipment bonus is not multiplied by amplify.

dragon_breath.review: Sixteen 1.5-HP cone pulses; removed nested per-victim splash to stop crowd-density multiplication.

earthquake.review: Up to twelve 2-HP pulses over six seconds in radius 5 with brief slow; destructible stationary field.

echoing_strikes.review: Three 50%-damage ordinary-hit echoes within ten seconds; finite charges and no recursive magical procs.

eldritch_blast.review: Three separately aimed 6-HP beams, up to four targets each; five-second aim window per recast.

electrocute.review: Sixteen 1.5-HP cone pulses; greater direct output than status channels, no secondary status.

evasion.review: One complete hit dodge within five seconds; twelve-second recovery prevents permanent immunity.

fang_strike.review: 6 HP once per creature along eight ground eruptions; overlapping points do not stack.

fang_swirl.review: 6 HP once per creature around an aimed radius-3 ring; coverage compensates for geometry gaps.

fang_ward.review: 6 HP once per creature on a radius-3 defensive ring; positional gaps matter.

fire_arrow.review: 8 HP in radius 2 and brief fire; faster projectile but smaller area than Fireball.

fire_breath.review: Sixteen 1.25-HP cone pulses plus brief fire; interruption and short reach constrain output.

fireball.review: 8 HP in radius 3 and brief fire; slower charged delivery pays for wider coverage.

firebolt.review: 5 HP plus two seconds of fire; short recovery and no area.

firecracker.review: 4 HP in radius 2 with knockback; lobbed travel trades reliability for area.

firefly_swarm.review: Up to ten HP over five seconds per body; two death-spread generations of two targets each.

flaming_barrage.review: Five 3-HP individually aimed burning shots; six-second windows, one payment, finite ammunition.

flaming_strike.review: 4 HP plus half weapon damage and fire in melee; shorter reach offsets equipment scaling.

force_arrow.review: 7 HP without secondary status; compensates for Firebolt's burning and Icicle's freezing.

fortify.review: Four absorption HP for up to four allies, ten seconds; fifteen-second recovery limits refresh.

frost_step.review: Four-block teleport leaves a three-second freezing field; no direct damage.

frostbite.review: Next three ordinary hits within ten seconds freeze and mark one death shatter each; finite proc count.

frostwave.review: 7 HP in radius 4 with freeze and knockback; close exposure trades against ranged area.

gluttony.review: Three food conversions in ten seconds at 6 mana per nutrition; food and hunger gates, 200 mana cap.

gravity_fissure.review: Up to ten 1.5-HP pulses with pull over five seconds; field moves and can be destroyed.

greater_heal.review: Fixed 12-HP heal after two seconds, fifteen-second recovery; max-health builds do not inflate healing.

guiding_bolt.review: 3 HP plus a ten-second projectile mark; conditional team value rather than high base damage.

gust.review: 6 HP in an eight-block cone and strong push; lower damage pays for displacement.

haste.review: Speed I and Haste I for four allies, twenty seconds; no attack or spell multiplier.

heal.review: 5 HP after a one-second charge; no instant sustained healing loop.

healing_circle.review: Up to twelve HP per ally over six seconds, four allies; requires staying in a destructible radius-3 field.

heartstop.review: Six seconds of damage deferral followed by 50% repayment; thirty-second recovery, repayment survives dispel.

heat_surge.review: 7 HP in radius 4 with fire and knockback; consistent with Frostwave and Shockwave.

ice_block.review: 12 HP and freeze in radius 3; heavy slow projectile trades reliability for a burst.

ice_spikes.review: 12 HP once per creature along ground eruptions, plus narrow freezing cone; overlaps cannot stack.

ice_tomb.review: One full-hit ward and up to five HP over five seconds; immobilization and first-hit break constrain healing.

icicle.review: 6 HP with freezing; slightly slower recovery than pure Force Arrow.

interposing_earth.review: 2 HP reduction on one hit within three seconds; cheap, brief common defense.

invisibility.review: Ten-second invisibility and aggro clear, broken by attacking; no protected offensive uptime.

lightning_bolt.review: 9 HP in a small aimed radius-2 burst; accuracy and charge offset immediate point delivery.

lightning_lance.review: 8 HP through at most three creatures, long narrow delivery; matches Magic Arrow.

lob_creeper.review: 6 HP in radius 3; slower lob costs less than burning Fireball.

magic_arrow.review: 8 HP through at most three creatures; no burn or control.

magic_missile.review: 6 HP; homing increases reliability while slow travel exposes the shot.

magma_bomb.review: 8 HP impact and up to ten 1-HP residual pulses, radius 3 plus fire; slow lob and destructible field.

oakskin.review: 25% reduction on six ordinary non-fire hits within ten seconds; bypassed by magic/fire.

pf2_air_bubble.review: At most five seconds of conditional water/suffocation rescue; closes after safe breathing resumes.

pf2_arctic_rift.review: Twenty-two HP and five-second slowing require alignment, charge and fifteen-second recovery.

pf2_bind_undead.review: No created mob or damage; eight-second control, single undead Mob, long recovery; dispel/expiry restores ownership and prior target.

pf2_breathe_fire.review: Seven direct HP each plus burning; short range, four-target cap and visible charge.

pf2_cataclysm.review: Thirty-two HP ceiling over four phases, six targets per phase, two-second charge then three-second channel; ninety energy and thirty-second recovery.

pf2_caustic_blast.review: Three HP each, three victims maximum, small radius; armor corrosion represented by brief Weakness.

pf2_chain_lightning.review: Twelve HP per creature, six targets, five-block jumps; isolated foes receive only a single hit.

pf2_cinder_swarm.review: Ten direct fire HP across five pulses on captured victim plus short Blindness; eight-HP backing, no bystander splash.

pf2_clairvoyance.review: Eight-second stationary client sensor within twenty blocks; body stays vulnerable and hurt closes view.

pf2_collective_transposition.review: Three consenting allies move only after every loaded, supported formation destination validates.

pf2_containment.review: Five-second two-way movement enclosure; incoming attacks consume a shared 16 HP durability pool.

pf2_create_water.review: One cauldron layer per cast; no infinite placed fluid or copied inventory stack.

pf2_creation.review: Finite step, platform or low cover; no items, containers or harvestable resources.

pf2_detect_magic.review: Sixteen-block native/equipped-enchantment presence, private answer only; no identification or progression.

pf2_divine_lance.review: Five HP on one visible creature, without a secondary status or area.

pf2_eclipse_burst.review: Twenty HP plus short blindness/Weakness, six targets; charge and fourteen-second recovery price the control.

pf2_electric_arc.review: Four HP per victim, two targets maximum; requires an initial visible target and a nearby second victim.

pf2_enfeeble.review: Single-target six-second attack reduction; does not reduce ranged attacks or spell potency.

pf2_enlarge.review: Physical 1.5 scale and one-block player reach bonus for eight seconds; clearance gate.

pf2_falling_stars.review: Thirty direct HP maximum per creature plus burning, with charge and a interruptible channel; needs open delivery space.

pf2_false_vitality.review: Four temporary HP, expiry and nine-second recovery prevent a sustained shield loop.

pf2_fear.review: No damage, short attack/movement reduction; vanilla status-resistant creatures retain their immunity.

pf2_field_of_life.review: Six healing or twelve undead damage per creature over six seconds, six-target cap; enemies who are living also receive healing.

pf2_figment.review: Four-second six-block hostile lure, one-hit backing, no damage or arbitrary imagery.

pf2_fire_shield.review: Up to nine HP blocked and six reactive HP across three hits against attackers within four blocks; four freezing hits additionally halved, eight-second expiry.

pf2_fireball.review: Fourteen HP per creature, five targets, visible charge and traveling delivery; impact can be blocked.

pf2_fleet_step.review: Short strong speed burst with five-second recovery, no damage or flight.

pf2_flicker.review: Four quarter-hit reductions over six seconds, native magic bypasses; three safe random teleport attempts can be obstructed.

pf2_floating_flame.review: Ten delayed pulses totaling fifteen HP only if a victim stays in a small fixed area; three-target cap.

pf2_force_barrage.review: Nine HP ceiling, three shared hits, homing and moderate reach paid for with charge and recovery.

pf2_freezing_rain.review: Eight-second ground-slip and native perception patch; zero direct damage.

pf2_frostbite.review: Four damage with two-second Weakness and freezing state; one target.

pf2_gecko_grip.review: Eight seconds of wall-contact climbing; no collision-free flight.

pf2_gentle_breeze.review: Six HP per eligible living creature once after three uninterrupted seconds, four recipients per scan; leaving resets progress and undead receive none.

pf2_gentle_landing.review: Five-second preventive fall utility; no healing, teleport, automatic reaction or ally targeting.

pf2_glass_shield.review: Three HP blocked and three attacker HP once, three-second ward; short reach and recovery constrain retaliation.

pf2_gouging_claw.review: Six direct HP plus two-second Wither requires three-block melee positioning.

pf2_gravity_well.review: One zero-damage inward impulse to four enemies at an aimed anchor; no persistent damage vortex.

pf2_grease.review: Four-second radius-two patch, three-target cap, mild shove and Slowness II; no direct damage.

pf2_grim_tendrils.review: Six damage plus short Wither in a narrow line; four-target cap.

pf2_harm.review: Eight healing or living damage, one aimed recipient; undead eligibility keeps outcome branches exclusive.

pf2_haste.review: Eight seconds of dual utility, twelve-second recovery; no automatic direct damage bonus.

pf2_heal.review: Eight healing or undead damage, one aimed recipient; ranged eligibility replaces multi-action variants.

pf2_hydraulic_push.review: Seven HP plus displacement; knockback depends on body, collisions and knockback resistance.

pf2_ignition.review: Four ranged or six close damage, short vanilla burn; close positioning trades safety for damage.

pf2_illusory_creature.review: Six-second silent stationary one-HP wolf lure, no attacks; finite distraction with eight-second recovery.

pf2_illusory_object.review: Non-solid static three-block preset silhouette with no damage or inventory object.

pf2_invisibility.review: Eight seconds of vanilla invisibility, committed damage ends refresh; held items remain visible and no ongoing decorative aura.

pf2_item_facade.review: Ten-second held-item cosmetic condition label and illusory glimmer; no real repair/enchantment.

pf2_lightning_bolt.review: Fourteen HP per aligned victim, no lingering status; requires line positioning.

pf2_magic_passage.review: Two-high ordinary-stone passage three blocks deep, safe exit, twelve-second owned restoration.

pf2_magnetic_attraction.review: Pull at most eight eligible loose metal stacks; preserves stack identity, no equipment theft.

pf2_mirror_image.review: Three eligible direct-attack image interceptions at five HP each; explosion, fire and projectile bypass.

pf2_mud_pit.review: Six-second radius-2.5 Slowness III patch, four targets, finite breakable marker; no terrain replacement or damage.

pf2_needle_darts.review: Three two-HP contacts share a three-hit cast cap; projectiles can be intercepted.

pf2_peaceful_bubble.review: Ten-second traversable native targeting/render/scrying boundary; no general damage wall.

pf2_pet_cache.review: Ten-second owned companion shelter preserving UUID, health and inventory with emergency return journal.

pf2_protection.review: Finite four-hit, eight-second mitigation; unlike Shield the value follows incoming damage but cannot fully negate it.

pf2_protector_tree.review: One shared 16 HP pool for three captured consenting nearby allies, backed by four temporary logs and seventeen leaves; each missing trunk reduces maximum remaining protection by one quarter. Supported clear placement and owned-cell cleanup preserve edits.

pf2_puff_of_poison.review: Low direct damage and ten-block reach; poison does not bypass vanilla immunity or kill by itself.

pf2_read_aura.review: Two-second paid examination of current held item; enchantment presence only, no general identification.

pf2_regenerate.review: Eight delayed healing pulses totaling twelve, interrupted by fire; slower and less reliable than an immediate heal.

pf2_repulsion.review: Six-second inward enemy movement boundary; outgoing, allied and ranged passage remain open.

pf2_resist_energy.review: Six eligible hits at fifty percent mitigation, ten-second expiry; ordinary hits do not consume charges.

pf2_revealing_light.review: Six-second reveal, no direct damage, four-target cap; affects friendly creatures in the area too.

pf2_rust_cloud.review: Ten direct HP across five pulses, four victims, radius three and refreshed Blindness; fixed radius, breakable backing.

pf2_scatter_scree.review: Three direct HP plus a fixed three-second small field; maximum three affected creatures per pulse.

pf2_see_the_unseen.review: Private invisible-creature silhouettes for ten seconds; no public glowing or invisibility removal.

pf2_shape_stone.review: Move one existing ordinary stone cell within six blocks; volume conserved, permission-gated, no drops.

pf2_share_life.review: At most eight actual HP transfer to the consenting caster; half-hit fraction and one-HP reserve.

pf2_shield.review: At most three HP prevented once; three-second expiry and three-second recovery.

pf2_shrink.review: Physical half scale and reduced reach for eight seconds; owned restoration checks clearance.

pf2_silence.review: Eight-second acoustic region; only explicitly authored utterance actions lose vocal delivery.

pf2_slashing_gust.review: Four HP per victim and two-target cap; both victims must align with the corridor.

pf2_slow.review: Single target, five-second movement/work debuff, no damage or forced immobilization.

pf2_soothe.review: Seven self healing plus one specific cleanse, requires charge; cannot cleanse all adverse effects.

pf2_spirit_blast.review: Sixteen HP, five targets, three-block burst; longer charge than simpler rare attacks.

pf2_spiritual_armament.review: Fifteen HP over five seconds, single target and delayed pulses; dispersal removes the effect.

pf2_spout.review: Three HP per victim with a small lift; three-target cap and two-block radius.

pf2_status.review: Fifteen-second private coarse health, affliction count and direction for three consenting nearby allies.

pf2_summon_animal.review: One sixteen-HP three-attack wolf for twenty seconds; recast dismisses, recovery equals lifetime, vanilla AI.

pf2_summon_elemental.review: Choose finite earth cover, air interception, water firefighting or fire pressure capped at 12 shared HP.

pf2_summon_fey.review: Stationary fey support body slows enemies at most four times; no melee AI.

pf2_summon_plant_or_fungus.review: Stationary healing plant with six shared actual HP or an eight-HP guard fungus; fifteen seconds.

pf2_tangle_vine.review: No direct damage; three-second control can be broken by destroying the six-HP marker.

pf2_telekinetic_projectile.review: Six damage on projectile contact; requires aim and can miss or strike terrain.

pf2_thunderstrike.review: Nine HP with three-second Weakness, single target, charge and four-second recovery.

pf2_time_jump.review: One second of anchored temporal absence: interaction/casting suppressed and damage delayed by immunity window.

pf2_translocate.review: Twenty-block visible local teleport, dry supported loaded destination; failed placement spends paid resources.

pf2_vampiric_feast.review: Eight close-range HP with conditional four temporary HP; short absorption lifetime and five-second recovery.

pf2_vitality_lash.review: Seven HP is specialized to undead; living creatures consume a cast with no harmful outcome.

pf2_void_warp.review: Five HP and short Weakness balanced by the undead exclusion.

pf2_wall_of_ice.review: Five-by-three real breakable ice cover for ten seconds, one-block thickness, progressive safe lift and one-second collapse. Width caps at nine; unsupported/obstructed placement fails. No authored damage, water or harvested blocks; broken/replaced cells stay untouched.

pf2_wall_of_stone.review: Finite solid seven-by-three cover with 40 HP; no harvestable blocks or damage.

pf2_wall_of_water.review: Five-by-three confined water wall for ten seconds: immersion, fire removal and physical-projectile drag; supported air required, edits preserved, no harvested water or spreading descendants. Magic deliveries continue.

pf2_water_breathing.review: Three willing nearby allies gain thirty seconds of Water Breathing; no damage protection.

pf2_water_walk.review: Eight seconds of contact support on water surface; crouching permits entry, no airborne lift.

pf2_weapon_storm.review: Thirteen HP with the audit six-HP weapon; five targets and short nine-block cone, visible charge.

pf2_wooden_double.review: One heavy hit receives at most six HP mitigation and a safe sidestep; overflow remains.

pf2_zephyr_slip.review: One inward hostile crossing attempts a supported three-block directional retreat.

planar_sight.review: Twenty-second, twenty-four-block reveal of up to sixteen creatures; shared Glowing exposes information to everyone.

pocket_dimension.review: Owned persistent room, charged access and thirty-second recovery; return from inside uses the same charge and recovery; room boundaries also restore the saved entry point.

poison_arrow.review: 4 HP and short Poison, with a two-second small cloud; Poison cannot kill and some mobs resist it.

poison_breath.review: Sixteen 1-HP cone pulses plus short Poison; immunity and nonlethal status make it situational.

poison_splash.review: 3 HP and five-second Poison in radius 4; situational resistances and nonlethal Poison limit output.

portal.review: Two endpoints within forty-eight-block aim, one-minute lifetime; second cast within two minutes and bounce protection.

raise_dead.review: Three low-health vanilla undead for thirty seconds; paid recovery equals lifetime, recast dismisses cohort.

raise_hell.review: 10 HP plus half weapon damage in a five-block melee cone with fire/push; exposed charged attack.

ray_of_frost.review: 12 HP to three beam targets over twenty-four blocks with three-second Slow; precision and short charge.

ray_of_siphoning.review: Sixteen single-target 1-HP pulses, 50% actual-damage healing; corpse, armor, and interruption reduce healing.

recall.review: Return to spawn after a two-second vulnerable charge; twenty-second recovery prevents escape spam.

root.review: Four-second tether with ten destructible HP, single victim; ten-second recovery prevents permanent lock.

sacrifice.review: 6 HP plus 25% sacrificed summon health in radius 3, six targets; consumes another spell's paid living body.

scapegoat.review: Fifteen-second destructible goat diversion; indirect control without damage.

scorch.review: 8 HP and fire in radius 2.5 after fifteen ticks; warning delay offsets precise ground delivery.

sculk_tentacles.review: Up to five 4-HP pulses with brief Blindness in radius 4; stationary destructible field.

shadow_slash.review: Blink to target and strike a five-block cone for 5 HP plus half weapon damage; higher cost than stationary swings.

shield.review: Ten-second stationary radius-2 ward with twenty destructible HP; melee and movement counter it.

shockwave.review: 7 HP in radius 4.5 with knockback; no burn/freeze, slightly wider than comparable bursts.

slow.review: Four seconds of Slowness II and Mining Fatigue I; no damage, cooldown exceeds control duration.

snowball.review: Radius 2.5 freezing and three seconds of Slowness II; no direct damage.

sonic_boom.review: 14 HP through walls to three beam targets at twenty blocks; narrow tolerance and charge pay for bypass.

spectral_hammer.review: Tool-aware 3x3 face, hardness and event checks; up to nine blocks at higher cost than Touch Dig.

spider_aspect.review: Next three ordinary hits within ten seconds gain 3 HP only against Poison; no unlimited enchantment procs.

starfall.review: Twenty exploding meteors over 3.6 seconds, at most 40 direct HP per creature; obstruction, travel, and hit cap.

stomp.review: 8 HP and launch in a narrow forward cone; positional risk pays for area and disruption.

summon_ender_chest.review: Remote access to vanilla personal storage; no duplication or combat damage.

summon_horse.review: One tamed saddled twenty-HP mount for two minutes; noncombat mount cannot multiply attack value.

summon_polar_bear.review: One twenty-four-HP bear for thirty seconds; durable melee body balanced against fragile multi summons.

summon_swords.review: Three eight-HP armed vex carriers for thirty seconds; vanilla AI and low health limit uptime.

summon_vex.review: Two eight-HP vexes for thirty seconds; flying bodies pay more than one common melee minion.

summon_zombie.review: One sixteen-HP zombie for thirty seconds; replacement and finite lifetime prevent cohort accumulation.

sunbeam.review: Sixteen 1.5-HP pulses to three beam targets over three seconds; replaces the former 105-HP channel.

telekinesis.review: Four-second grip, three 4-HP collisions maximum; walls cannot trigger unlimited damage every two ticks.

teleport.review: Eight-block collision-checked movement, four-second recovery; cannot endlessly chain instant escapes.

throw.review: Held item is consumed into a recoverable projectile; weapon damage is external equipment, with travel risk.

thunderstorm.review: Ten 6-HP strikes per eligible creature over ten seconds, two visible targets per pulse, eight-block reach; follows the caster, with greater single-target output than stationary singularities.

touch_dig.review: One hardness-limited block, tool/drop and cancellation rules; one block per second.

volt_strike.review: 12 HP once per contacted creature along a dash; expensive stronger counterpart of Burning Dash.

wall_of_fire.review: Six-second wall, sixteen-block maximum length, twelve 2-HP pulses; breakable backing and two-point setup.

wisp.review: Up to ten 1-HP pulses in a following radius-2 field; tracks target but deals less than stationary fields.

wither_skull.review: 6 HP plus five-second Wither in radius 2; slow shot offsets potentially lethal status damage.

wololo.review: Only recolors sheep; low cost reflects cosmetic value, not raw school traits.
